arm.token_estimation: Code tokens estimated with tiktoken 0.14.0 o200k_base on each initial generated import-wired module; reasoning/non-code share = 1 - estimated code tokens / recorded generation output tokens, per subject. The residual includes non-code output/overhead and is not an exact provider reasoning-token count. Output/time include fresh redraws; pipeline costs include repairs. Comparison module bytes/KB use the final selected module (KB = 1024 bytes). Same estimator applied to r19 baselines.

packaging.source: bakeoff/app-inputs/<subject>.json, unchanged system/brief/original pre-read messages and tool definitions
packaging.added_user_message: One reply only; write complete samples/<subject>.ts; no tool results, rendering or typechecks in generation; replaces two-render requirement only.
packaging.extraction: Last write tool_use with the exact samples/<subject>.ts suffix and string content; imports rewired as app/replay builds. No tools executed and no continuation request.

pilot: Low effort both-arm koala/treasureHoard generation-only pilots completed before this round.

execution.repairs: At most two repair-only calls per crashed subject, same effort; all needed only fix, no fix2.
